reports.title: RB Global reports third quarter 2026 results

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: The Company has updated its full-year 2026 outlook for select financial data, as shown below:

(in millions, except percentages) | Current Outlook | Prior Outlook(as provided on August 4, 2026)
GTV growth | 14% to 15% | 9% to 11%
Adjusted EBITDA | $1,525 to $1,545 | $1,495 to $1,545
Full year tax rate (GAAP and adjusted) | 22% to 24% | 23% to 25%
Capital expenditures4 | $350 to $400 | $350 to $400
1 For information regarding RB Global's use and definition of certain measures, see “Key Operating Metrics” and “Non-GAAP Measures” sections in this news release.

desk.headline: Revenue up 17% to $1.27bn and adjusted EPS $1.03, both beat; full-year GTV and EBITDA outlook raised
results: Revenue rose 17% to $1.27bn, well above the $1.17bn estimate, as GTV grew 20% to $4.7bn with gains in both automotive (+18%) and heavy equipment (+19%).
Adjusted EPS rose 11% to $1.03, ahead of the roughly $1.00 estimate; GAAP EPS jumped 63% to $0.70, helped by an $18.2m one-off excise tax refund.
Service revenue grew 10% but the take rate fell to 19.8% from 21.7%, reflecting acquisitions, more automotive remarketing and real estate sales.
Inventory sales revenue climbed 40% to $346.5m and the inventory margin improved to 5.2%.
Repurchased $350m of shares in the quarter ($500m this year) and declared a $0.33 quarterly dividend; net debt is 1.8x adjusted EBITDA.

guidance.summary: RB Global lifted its 2026 GTV growth outlook to 14–15% from 9–11% and raised the bottom of its adjusted EBITDA range, now $1,525–1,545m. The tax-rate range moved down a point and capex is unchanged.
